faq.question: Q1. What is Punjabi University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Punjabi University Campus, Maur (Bathinda) for hiring an Assistant Professor in History on a temporary arrangement for the academic session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Assistant Professor post in History.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by hand or via email is 16-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 19.10.2026 at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must fulfill UGC 2018 guidelines for Assistant Professor positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs 30,000/- per month for PhD/NET passed candidates and Rs 22,000/- per month for those without NET/PhD.

faq.question: Q7. Where should applications be sent?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted by hand at the office or emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
